=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3396-3397 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only --no-messages HEAD HEAD` is invoked with only 2 tree arguments instead of 3.
  WHY: The reviewer reported this causes a usage error and makes the capability probe fail even on modern Git.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3396-3417 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight merge probe log/comment describe the opposite merge direction from the `git merge-tree` invocation.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on impact—some called it cosmetic while others said it can mislead debugging or miss asymmetric conflicts—but they all identified the same direction mismatch.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3408 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The capability probe uses `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only --no-messages HEAD HEAD` as a warm-up check.
  WHY: The reviewer said it is unnecessary and creates a dangling tree object / object-store churn.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3409-3410 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight probe fetch is tolerated with `|| true` without verifying that refs were refreshed.
  WHY: The reviewer said a transient fetch failure could leave stale refs in place and the probe would read an outdated merge state.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3413-3420 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only --no-messages "refs/remotes/origin/${default_branch}" "refs/remotes/origin/${integration_branch}"` is invoked with only 2 tree arguments instead of 3.
  WHY: The reviewer said it exits non-zero with a usage error and prevents the intended short-circuit.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3421, 3468 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `mark_integration_sync_clean "${default_branch}"` is called where the helper may not accept an argument.
  WHY: The reviewer said a signature mismatch would leave `integration_sync_status=failed` spuriously if the helper rejects the positional argument.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3453-3465 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The mergeable-status fallback returns `false` on API failure without logging why.
  WHY: Both reviewers said the fail-open path can silently skip recovery/terminalization decisions and makes outages hard to distinguish from a real non-mergeable PR.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3331-3334 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `_list_integration_conflict_files` comment describes the opposite merge direction from the code.
  WHY: The reviewer said the documentation will mislead maintainers because the comment and implementation disagree on which branch is being merged into which.

- README.md:122 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The `INTEGRATION_CONFLICT_LIFETIME_MAX` documentation describes the wrong merge direction.
  WHY: The reviewer said the README text says the merge is into `default_branch` when the code checks the opposite direction.
